title: Reading from the mushaf: short passages with the laam rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Reading from the mushaf rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 24. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى (١١) ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (١٢) ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ (١٣) قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ (١٤) وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ (١٥)

keywords.def: the written copy of the Qur'an
a mark that doubles a letter
the letter ل; its rules decide if it is said, merged, heavy or light

questions.q: Read «بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا» (87:16) from the mushaf and name the marks you see.
questions.a: Sukoon on ل in بَلْ; dagger alif in ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ; sun letter د in ٱلدُّنْيَا.

questions.q: In «ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ» we read the small alif as ...
Mushaf reading turns: each pupil reads 2 ayat of Al-A'la from the mushaf to the teacher. Everyone else: read 88:17 to 20 from the mushaf, finding each laam.
questions.a: Each pupil reads accurately from the page; laam rules applied.

questions.q: Extend: find the dagger alif in 87:19.
questions.a: إِبْرَٰهِيمَ: a small alif after the raa.

questions.q: Stretch: read a new passage, 87:16 to 19, before we memorise it.
The small wavy sign (ٓ) above a letter means ...
options: stretch the madd 4 or more counts
questions.a: A) stretch the madd 4 or more counts. It is the maddah sign: a longer madd (muttasil, munfasil or lazim).

questions.q: Think again: Reading from the mushaf is different from reciting from memory. What extra things do your eyes need to look for?
questions.a: Marks such as sukoon, shaddah, the maddah sign, small letters and stopping signs.
